{{Quote|I've dissected hundreds of tuk'ata, forging a direct connection to the dark side. Each beast I examine advances me toward perfect unity.|Renning|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Renning''' was a corpulent [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] of [[Darth Malora|Malora]] and [[Dominique]] who had many resources made available to him by the [[Dark Council]] so that he could further the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] knowledge. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] thought he was wasting the Empire's time and attempted to sabotage one of his [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] experiments. Renning was displeased by her action toward his experiments and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] her by releasing a bolt of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] as punishment.

Renning was killed when a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team was [[Korriban Incursion|sent to secure]] Sith [[Datacron/Legends|datacrons]] and [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] on Korriban.
